notes: PUPPET-301. AskUserQuestion REVIEW pane, captured live against claude 2.1.251 by asking TWO questions in one call and answering both. bytes.raw also contains, earlier in the stream, both multi-question QUESTION panes (Color then Size) — the '☒ Color  ☐ Size' transition after the first digit is direct live proof that a bare digit selects AND advances, with no CR needed and no CR leaking into the next pane. prompt: Use the AskUserQuestion tool once to ask me exactly TWO questions in a single call. Question 1: header "Color", text "Which color should I use?", options "Red" and "Blue". Question 2: header "Size", text "Which size should I use?", options "Small" and "Large". Do not do anything else first.
keystrokes: '1' — answers question 1 (Red) and advances to question 2; tab strip flips to '☒ Color  ☐ Size'
'1' — answers question 2 (Small); the dialog advances to the review pane

findings.q2_glyphs: Highlight glyph is still ❯ (U+276F). Tab strip glyphs are still ☐/☒/✔ with ←/→ arrows on the multi-tab strip. Observed tab strip: '←  ☐ Color  ☐ Size  ✔ Submit  →' before any answer, '←  ☒ Color  ☒ Size  ✔ Submit  →' on the review pane
findings.q3_footer_and_review_anchor: Footer still starts with 'Enter to select ·' — observed in full as: 'Enter to select · Tab/Arrow keys to navigate · Esc to cancel' on the two QUESTION panes (note: the navigation clause differs from the single-question pane's '↑/↓ to navigate', but the required anchor prefix 'Enter to select ·' is unchanged). The REVIEW pane has no such footer and anchors on 'Ready to submit your answers?', which is present verbatim.

findings.q6_review_pane: YES, unchanged. The review pane still renders exactly two rows, '❯ 1. Submit answers' and '  2. Cancel', under a 'Review your answers' summary block of '● <question>' / '→ <answer>' lines and the 'Ready to submit your answers?' anchor. reviewAlias still maps 'Submit answers' -> 'proceed' and 'Cancel' -> 'deny'.

recorder: test/corpus/tools/record-pty.ts --interactive, over the production PTY bridge (src/wrapper/internal/pty.ts). Keystrokes were fed to the tool's stdin through a FIFO rather than typed at a tty (an agent has no interactive terminal); record-pty's own code path is unchanged and every keystroke is timestamped in stdin.log as usual.
version_note: `claude --version` was re-probed at capture time and reported 2.1.251 (Claude Code) — the version this ticket targets. No discrepancy to record.
trust_note: The recording cwd was `git init`-ed and trust was granted in an EARLIER, discarded session, so the folder-trust dialog does not appear anywhere in this recording. bytes.raw starts at the alt-screen enter (ESC[?1049h) of a clean composer.
teardown_note: bytes.raw is TRUNCATED at the last byte of the settled dialog frame, deliberately, before the Ctrl-] detach teardown. SIGTERM makes claude leave the alt screen (ESC[?1049l) and print 'Resume this session with: claude --resume <id>', and a stream ending there replays as the resume text instead of the dialog. Same trap documented in permission-mode-bypass/meta.json.
expected_note: expected.txt was PRODUCED BY REPLAYING bytes.raw through src/screen's Screen at 120x40 and serializing as screenbench-record does (finalText.replace(/\s+$/u, '') + '\n'). It is not hand-typed.
